oracle_separation: Every candidate finishes before offline oracle examination. No oracle answer is supplied to the candidate.

inventory.experiment: Generation only: exhaustive bounded integer-grid guillotine histories

completeness.objects: All finite ordered legal histories, including empty and every stopping length up to max_cuts.
completeness.basis: The empty frame is the unique depth-zero history.
completeness.induction: For each history, visit every current cell and every strictly interior integer x or y; each legal next cut occurs once and produces its exact two children.
completeness.termination: Each cut increases cell count by one, up to width*height; max_cuts also bounds depth. A resource cap is reported separately.
completeness.ordering: Breadth first; cells lexicographic (x0,y0,x1,y1); vertical then horizontal; coordinates increasing.
completeness.deduplication: Only canonical undirected input stroke sets with frame; retain every history and prefix alias, collinear segmentation, and grid orientation.
completeness.colors: No color assignment or color symmetry is involved; no precolored states are generated.
completeness.scope: Integer-grid guillotine rectangular subdivisions with full-cell cuts, not all plane maps or all rectangular layouts.
completeness.shared_code: Existing canonical_document and stroke_set_key only; no policy, oracle, or geometry exporter is called by generation.
completeness.numerical_boundary: Exact integer grid certificates are scaled to the engine's 900x600 frame; geometry export and numerical acceptance require separate verification.
